text:
oliver-ops: Proposal: run privatelink cutover for keystore in eu-west-1 next Tue 07:00 UTC. This should let us remove the broad fw carveouts and avoid future warm-pool onboarding churn. Need signoffs + cost ack.
mira-infra: +1 on cutover, but suggest we do a canary in 1 AZ first. Warm pools are sensitive to decrypt failures.
zoe-sre: Agreed. Preflight checklist: DNS -> privatelink endpoint, kubelet decrypt smoke test, autoscaler backoff bump. Canary should create an ephemeral node and run 50 decrypt attempts.
anil-sec: Security thumbs-up for privatelink, but require audit logging capture for the cutover and a 30m stable-success window before removing any carveouts.
oliver-ops: Finance: what is the incremental cost for privatelink endpoints vs keeping carveouts open? finance-bot: Estimated incremental recurring cost ~ $1.1k/month for eu-west-1 (endpoint + data processing). One-time eng effort ~ 2 engineer-days.
mira-infra: Plan sketch: 1) deploy privatelink in az-a as canary, 2) run 50 warm-pool joins verifying no KMS_DECRYPT_ERRs, 3) promote to other AZs, 4) remove fw exception with sec signoff. Automation in repo: `infra/privatelink/keystore-cutover.sh`.
oliver-ops: Who owns rollback? zoe-sre? also we'll change autoscaler backoff to reduce churn during the window (30s -> 5m with jitter).
zoe-sre: I'll own rollback and monitoring. I'll add a dashboard: keystore.decrypt_errors, warmpool.join_rate, autoscaler.retries. Opening PR for checklist and dashboard now.
anil-sec: Conditions for approval: 1) packet capture allowed for 1h during canary for debug, 2) incident ticket #keystore-privatelink-cutover created and linked to audit logs.
oliver-ops: I'll file change request when PR is merged. Tentative change id `ch-9345`, 60m window Tue 07:00 UTC. Any blockers?
mira-infra: no blockers from infra. +1.
deploy-bot: Change request ch-9345 queued by oliver-ops at 2026-03-26T10:12:00Z. Linked to incident #keystore-privatelink-cutover.
zoe-sre: After canary, if decrypt errors > 0 for 10% of joins we roll back and re-open carveout. Postmortem owner assigned. Closing thread after PR merge and change booking.
